<!-- # ###################################################################################################################
# Script creating plots of key outputs for analysing SNOMED stillbirth codelist trends over time and codelist changes over time
#
# 1. Total SNOMED code prevalence over time 
# 2. Codelist specific total code prevalence over time 
# 3. Latest year top 10 most frequently used codes in the codelist
# 4. Coding trends of most prevalent codes over the whole period (top 10 codes every year)
# ###################################################################################################################
 -->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Document settings 
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Import libraries
# if(!require(tidyverse)) install.packages("tidyverse", repos = "https://cran.ma.imperial.ac.uk/")
# if(!require(dplyr)) install.packages("dplyr", repos = "https://cran.ma.imperial.ac.uk/")
# if(!require(ggplot2)) install.packages("ggplot2", repos = "https://cran.ma.imperial.ac.uk/")
# if(!require(gridExtra)) install.packages("gridExtra", repos = "https://cran.ma.imperial.ac.uk/")

#remotes::install_github("bennettoxford/opencodecounts")

# ("C:/Program Files/RStudio/resources/app/bin/quarto/bin/tools")

library(opencodecounts)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(webshot2)
library(magick)
library(ggtext)
library(ggrepel)

# Input directory ----
input_dir_os <- here("snomed_outputs")

# Output directory ----
output_dir_rmd <- here("snomed_outputs")
#fs::dir_create(output_dir_rmd)

# Import SNOMED data
snomed <- opencodecounts::snomed_usage

# Add year column
snomed$year <- format(as.Date(snomed$start_date), "%Y")
```

```{r, codelist summary trend, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis', fig.width=10, out.width = '100%', fig.cap = "Figure 2 Total national SNOMED code frequency for the stillbirth SNOMED codelist by financial year", fig.topcaption=TRUE}
########################################
# Codelist specific outputs

# Import the codelist
# Create a list to store codelists with associated names
codelists <- list()

# Define a vector of names and corresponding inputs for the codelists
codelist_inputs <- list(
  Delivery = "user/VickiPalin/deliver_codes_20_12_2024/19a8bc08/",
  Postnatal  = "user/VickiPalin/pregnancy_postnatal_8wk_snomed_reviewed/021cbb8d/",
  # Outcomes
  Stillbirth = "user/VickiPalin/pregnancy_stillbrith_snomed_reviewed/15ecde31/",
  Multiples = "user/VickiPalin/pregnancy_multiple_snomed/3b37f1fe/",
  Preeclampsia = "user/VickiPalin/preeclampsia/63cdf7c6/",
  Hypertension = "user/djlhayes/high-risk-pregnancy/70b410f6",
  Hypertension = "opensafely/hypertension-snomed/024ab1b0"
)

# Loop through the inputs and populate the codelists
for (name in names(codelist_inputs)) {
  codelists[[name]] <- get_codelist(codelist_inputs[[name]])
}

# Create objects for each codelist
Delivery <- codelists[["Delivery"]]
Postnatal <- codelists[["Postnatal"]]
Stillbirth <- codelists[["Stillbirth"]]
Multiples <- codelists[["Multiples"]]
Preeclampsia <- codelists[["Preeclampsia"]]
Hypertension <- codelists[["Hypertension"]]

# Filter to codes contained in the codelist
# Loop through each codelist and filter the snomed data
sb_codelist_data <- list()

for (name in names(codelists)) {
  sb_codelist_data[[name]] <- snomed |>
    filter(snomed_code %in% codelists[[name]]$code)
}

# test create individual variables
# delivery_data <- sb_codelist_data[["delivery"]]

# Optionally, combine all filtered data into a single data frame if needed
sb_codelist_data <- bind_rows(sb_codelist_data, .id = "codelist_name")

# Summarise usage by year
sb_codelist_data_summary <- sb_codelist_data %>%
    group_by(codelist_name, year) %>%
    summarise(total_usage = sum(usage, na.rm = TRUE))

## 2. Codelist specific total code prevalence over time 
# Create a list to store plots for each codelist
sb_codelist_data_summary_plots <- list()

# Loop through each codelist and create a plot with auto-scaled axes
for (codelist in unique(sb_codelist_data_summary$codelist_name)) {
  data_subset <- sb_codelist_data_summary %>% filter(codelist_name == codelist)
  # Increase y-axis scaling by adding a small margin above the max value
  y_max <- max(data_subset$total_usage, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(data_subset$total_usage, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_lim <- c(y_min * 0.75, y_max * 1.10) # max is 15% higher than max value

  p <- ggplot(data = data_subset, aes(x = year, y = total_usage)) +
    geom_line(aes(group=1)) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(
      title = paste(codelist),
      x = "Year",
      y = "Total Usage"
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 13)) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10),
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1),
      limits = y_lim
    )
  sb_codelist_data_summary_plots[[codelist]] <- p
  # Save each plot
  ggsave(
    here::here(output_dir_rmd, "figures", paste0("snomed_", codelist, "_codelist_summary_plot.png")),
    p,
    width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 120
  )
  # Include each plot in the document
  include_graphics(fs::path(output_dir_rmd, "figures", paste0("snomed_", codelist, "_codelist_summary_plot.png")))
}

```

```{r, codelist top 10 table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include = FALSE, out.width = '100%'}
## 3. Latest year top 10 most frequently used codes in the codelist
# Filter codelist to latest year only
sb_codelist_data_latest_year <- sb_codelist_data |>
  filter(year == "2023") #|>

# Calculate proportional usage for each code for latest year, grouped by codelist_name
sb_codelist_data_latest_year <- sb_codelist_data_latest_year |>
  group_by(codelist_name, snomed_code, description, year) |>
  summarise(usage = sum(usage), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(codelist_name) |>
  mutate(prop_usage = usage / sum(usage)) |>
  ungroup()

# Select top 10 most frequently used codes by proportional usage
sb_top_10_codes <- sb_codelist_data_latest_year |>
  group_by(codelist_name) |>
  slice_max(prop_usage, n = 10) |>
  ungroup()

# Create a table showing the SNOMED codes, description, usage, and prop_usage
# Create a list to store tables for each codelist
sb_top_10_codes_tables <- list()

# Loop through each codelist and create a table
for (codelist in unique(sb_top_10_codes$codelist_name)) {
  sb_top_10_codes_tables[[codelist]] <- sb_top_10_codes %>%
    filter(codelist_name == codelist) %>%
    select(snomed_code, description, usage, prop_usage) %>%
    mutate(
      prop_usage = scales::percent(prop_usage, accuracy = 0.1),
      usage = scales::comma(usage)
    )
}

# Update the column names of all tibbles in sb_top_10_codes_tables
for (codelist in names(sb_top_10_codes_tables)) {
  colnames(sb_top_10_codes_tables[[codelist]]) <- c("SNOMED code", "SNOMED code description", "Frequency", "Proportion")
}


# Loop through each codelist table and export as HTML and PNG
for (codelist in names(sb_top_10_codes_tables)) {
  table_html_path <- file.path("snomed_outputs/tables", paste0("top_10_snomed_", codelist, "_codes_table.html"))
  table_png_path <- file.path("snomed_outputs/tables", paste0("top_10_snomed_", codelist, "_codes_table.png"))

  # Render HTML table
  sb_top_10_codes_tables[[codelist]] %>%
    kable(row.names = FALSE,
          align = c("l", "l", "c", "c"),
          booktabs = TRUE,
          caption = paste(codelist),
          table.attr = "style='width:40%;'",
          title = codelist
    ) %>%
    column_spec(1, width = "10em") %>%
    column_spec(2, width = "30em") %>%
    kable_styling(position = "center", full_width = TRUE, bootstrap_options = "striped", font_size = 20) %>%
    kableExtra::footnote(" Values for financial year 2023-24", general_title = "") %>%
    save_kable(file = table_html_path, zoom = 1.5)

  # Dynamically set height based on number of rows
  n_rows <- nrow(sb_top_10_codes_tables[[codelist]]) + 3.25 # add for header/caption/footnote
  height_px <- max(300, n_rows * 60) # 60px per row, min 300px

  # Use webshot2 to capture the table with adjusted height
  webshot2::webshot(
    url = table_html_path,
    file = table_png_path,
    vwidth = 1200,
    vheight = height_px,
    zoom = 2.5
  )
}

```

```{r, codelist top 10 trend over time, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis', fig.height=8, out.height='100%', fig.width=10, out.width = '100%', fig.cap = "Figure 3 SNOMED code usage trends for the top 10 most frequent SNOMED codes recorded annually for the SNOMED stillbirth codelist", fig.topcaption=TRUE}
## 4. Top 10 most frequently used codes in the codelist for each year, combined and plotted across all years

# Calculate proportional usage for each code for latest year
sb_codelist_data_percent <- sb_codelist_data |>
  group_by(codelist_name,snomed_code, description, year) |>
  summarise(usage = sum(usage), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(codelist_name,year) %>%
  mutate(prop_usage = usage/ sum(usage)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create a list to store the top 10 SNOMED codes by percent for each year and codelist
sb_top_10_allyear_codes_list <- list()

for (codelist in unique(sb_codelist_data_percent$codelist_name)) {
  sb_top_10_allyear_codes_list[[codelist]] <- sb_codelist_data_percent %>%
    filter(codelist_name == codelist) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    slice_max(prop_usage, n = 10) %>%
    pull(snomed_code) %>%
    unique()
}

# Optionally, combine into a data frame for easier downstream use
sb_top_10_allyear_codes <- tibble(
  codelist_name = rep(names(sb_top_10_allyear_codes_list), 
                      times = sapply(sb_top_10_allyear_codes_list, length)),
  snomed_code = unlist(sb_top_10_allyear_codes_list)
)

# Filter data to only those snomed codes which were in the top 10 in any year 
sb_top_codes_data <- sb_codelist_data_percent %>%
  semi_join(sb_top_10_allyear_codes, by = c("codelist_name", "snomed_code"))

# Add a field to be used as a label, and complete for those label rows. 
sb_top_10_codes_each_year <- sb_top_codes_data %>% 
  mutate(snomed_code_description = paste(snomed_code, description, sep = " - ")) %>%
  mutate(name_lab = if_else((year == "2023"), snomed_code_description, NA_character_))

# write results to a table
write.csv(sb_top_10_codes_each_year, file ="snomed_outputs/tables/top_10_snomed_sb_codes_each_year.csv")    

# add string wrapping for labelling to snomed_code_description field values
sb_top_10_codes_each_year$snomed_code_description <- stringr::str_wrap(sb_top_10_codes_each_year$snomed_code_description, 35)

## Top 10 codes for each year plotted over whole time period, faceted by codelist_name

# Create a list to store plots for each codelist
sb_top_10_codes_all_years_plots <- list()

for (codelist in unique(sb_top_10_codes_each_year$codelist_name)) {
  data_subset <- sb_top_10_codes_each_year %>% filter(codelist_name == codelist)
  y_max <- max(data_subset$usage, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_lim <- c(0, y_max * 1.15) # 15% higher than max

  p <- ggplot(data = data_subset, aes(x = year, y = usage)) +
    geom_line(aes(color = snomed_code_description, group = snomed_code_description)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = snomed_code_description)) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      aes(
        x = year,
        y = usage,
        color = name_lab,
        label = stringr::str_wrap(name_lab, 25),
        fontface = 'bold'
      ),
      lineheight = 0.7,
      hjust = 1,
      data = data_subset %>% filter(year == max(year)),
      segment.color = 'dark grey',
      min.segment.length = 0,
      segment.linetype = 2,
      seed = 42,
      max.overlaps = 15,
      direction = "y",
      nudge_x = 2,
      size = 2.8,
      box.padding = .2,
      force = .8
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(codelist),
      x = "Year",
      y = "Usage",
      color = "SNOMED Code"
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 15)) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10),
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1),
      limits = y_lim
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  sb_top_10_codes_all_years_plots[[codelist]] <- p

  # Save each plot
  ggsave(
    here::here(output_dir_rmd, "figures", paste0("top_10_snomed_", codelist, "_codes_all_years_plot.png")),
    p,
    width = 30, units = "cm"
  )

  # Include each plot in the document
  include_graphics(fs::path(output_dir_rmd, "figures", paste0("top_10_snomed_", codelist, "_codes_all_years_plot.png")))
}
```
